prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
COMPANY We are a UK cyber security company established in 1999. Please do not message us on Linkedin, social media, or email. You will be removed from consideration. All messaging should be on Upwork. WORK We are looking for a software engineer to provide solutions for various business needs. An expert, who can help with web application integration, workflow automation, email sequences, custom checkout pages, subscriptions, community management, etc. A variety of work will involve technology you are an expert in, and some that you will be required to learn. You will need to be able to learn fast about the tech you don't know and use your initiative to provide solutions to evolving technical challenges. Submit some of your best campaigns so that we can get an idea of your work. REQUIRED SKILLS * Zapier * API programming * OpenAI/ChatGPT (knowledge of) * Google sheets * PHP * WordPress plugin development * Javascript and frameworks COMMON SKILLS * Must be fluent in English, both spoken and written. * Able to attend voice meetings over Zoom * Work on Slack for messaging * Experience with Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs. * Fully remote working * We work UK hours roughly 4 am - 3 pm (Flexible based on deliverables). * Attention to detail QUALIFICATIONS & WORK EXPERIENCE * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or an equivalent * 3-5 years of experience in software engineering * Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role INTERVIEW & SELECT
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Shopify customer segments
client: Juniper & Ash Home
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2023-01
end: 2023-02
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Google Sheets
- Looker Studio
- Shopify
implied_skills:
- RFM segmentation
built: Customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency and spend,
  fed to the email tool.
metrics:
- top segment is 9% of customers and 41% of revenue
- email revenue +19%

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Shopify customer segments (p09).
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a fast-learning engineer who can connect tools, automate workflows, and build reliable solutions across web apps, email, and data-driven systems.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. On Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports using recency, frequency, and spend, fed them to the email tool, and the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue; email revenue increased by 19%.  

I’m comfortable working in spreadsheets, handling messy data, and turning business logic into clear, usable outputs. I also learn quickly and can apply that to the tools you use.  

Which part of the workflow needs the most immediate attention: automation, integrations, or custom checkout/subscription work?
